name: RSPCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a one-night Iron Man tournament at the fed's own debut supercard and renamed within its first year for the champion whose kayfabe injury ended his career.

name: RSPCW Television Championship
epitaph: The federation's secondary singles title, changing hands twice more within its first six months on this wing's own textual record.

name: RSPCW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won in a cage match at the fed's own debut supercard; the winning pair is withheld under the privacy rule.
